name: observability
description: Unified observability plugin: session lifecycle hooks (start/stop/cleanup/logger-init/logger-tool) + Langfuse telemetry & scoring (score-detector + push-score + accuracy-efficiency). Single bundled langfuse-helper.js (no cross-plugin duplication). Granular control: SKIP_LANGFUSE=1 disables only Langfuse push behavior while keeping session logs active.
